name: bulc-building-designer
description: AI control of the BULC fire & evacuation simulator from Claude — geometry, Shape Studio, mesh, simulation settings, outputs, fire, detectors, sprinkler, HVAC and evacuation.
long_description:
BULC MCP Server connects Claude to the BULC desktop application and drives it in natural language: "make a 8x6 m room", "split the mesh at x=4", "put a 500 kW/m2 fire in the middle", "set the ambient temperature to 25 C", "add a temperature slice at y=3", "check the deck and run it".

It is a thin client of the bridge that BULC itself hosts on 127.0.0.1, and it runs the very same tool set the app's built-in AI assistant uses. Whatever the installed version of BULC can do, this server exposes:
- Geometry: obstacles, walls, floors, doors, windows, holes, move/scale/rotate, furniture catalogue
- Shape Studio: primitives, booleans, arrays, arches and vaults, voxel or &GEOM export, STL/OBJ
- Mesh: single mesh, multi-mesh, slice/merge, shape-driven auto meshing, cut-cell meshing
- Settings: end time, simulation mode, turbulence, numerics (CFL/VN/flux limiter), ambient conditions
- Output: CHID, slices (SLCF), boundary quantities (BNDF), Plot3D, dump intervals, deck preview
- Fire and materials, detectors and controls, sprinkler piping (SPR), HVAC ducting, evacuation (EVAC)
- Pre-flight validation and starting the simulation

Requires the BULC desktop application to be installed and running.
